p: rest on every side: He declares that he was bound to set forth God's glory for as much as the Lord had sent him rest and peace.
hire for thy servants according to: This was his equity, that he would not receive a benefit without some recompence.
Hiram heard the words of Solomon: In Hiram is prefigured the calling of the Gentiles who would help build the spiritual temple.
my household: While my servants are occupied with your business.
two made a league together: Concerning the furniture of wood.
builders did hew them: The Hebrew word is Giblim, which some say were excellent masons.
